methodology.speedUnits: pixels/second; matched IDs active in both adjacent frames
methodology.amplitudeUnits: pixels; maximum distance from the mean centroid
methodology.phaseOffset: positive when region follows the body; maximum circular correlation of centroid speeds; null when unreliable
methodology.silhouetteIoU: overlap of occupied pixels; aligned metric compensates rounded centroid translation
methodology.transitions: last entry measures frame N to frame 1 (loop seam)
caveats: Particle-ID reassignment can inflate matched-particle speed without visible silhouette motion.
Region membership is inherited from source anatomy and is not re-segmented for each pose.
This file measures reference target poses, not the actual spring-driven Canvas trajectory.
One observed loop does not establish a general motion style or subjective intention.
